purpose: Single source of truth for how the topic linker decides two artifacts are the SAME topic. The LLM judge applies these rules at runtime, /live/rules renders them for humans, and agents read this same file in the repo. Cosine similarity only nominates candidates; these rules decide.
how_it_works: 1. Embedding cosine over thread/resource summaries nominates a shortlist (adaptive cutoff: mean+2σ over the corpus, floor 0.65).
2. The judge classifies each artifact into ONE tag below, then applies that tag's criteria.
3. If the two artifacts have different tags, the tie-breakers decide (a bug and the investigation of that bug CAN be the same topic).
4. Verdicts are cached per pair + content hash; a changed summary re-judges. Confirmed pairs become SAME_TOPIC edges carrying tag, confidence, topic and why.

tags.classify_when: Something is broken or wrong: errors, outages, alert spikes, stuck/failed payments, wrong status or amounts, data inconsistencies.
tags.same_when: Same ROOT CAUSE — the same failing mechanism or code path — even if the symptoms, affected payments, or channels differ. A specific broken payment and the macro incident caused by the same mechanism are the SAME topic.
tags.different_when: Same symptom class but a different cause (two payments both stuck for unrelated reasons); same partner but unrelated defects.
tags.example_same: 'Payment pxx6xgkdtl wrongly flipped to Abandoned (status-sync misreads Juspay 400)' ↔ 'Investigation: abandonment spike caused by status-sync mis-tagging' — one mechanism, two views.
tags.example_different: 'Payment stuck: Juspay refund API age limit' ↔ 'Payment stuck: Tabby capture timeout' — both stuck payments, different causes.

tags.classify_when: Tracing a specific order/payment/booking through logs, Athena, BigQuery, or dashboards (EnzoBot log checks are the canonical case).
tags.same_when: Concerns the same payment/order/booking id, OR both traces land on one shared underlying defect.
tags.different_when: Merely both being log investigations. Same activity ('EnzoBot, check logs for X') is NEVER the same topic by itself — the subject decides.
tags.example_same: Two threads tracing order wg_123 through different systems.
tags.example_different: 'check logs for pxx6xgkdtl' ↔ 'check logs for p9696jn5v7' — identical activity, different subjects (unless both hit the same defect).

tags.classify_when: Building or changing product behavior: new payment method, flow change, pricing, UX, enablement/rollout.
tags.same_when: Same user-facing capability or outcome in the same domain. Within payments: same FLOW (checkout, refund, 3DS, payment-link, …) AND — when the work is partner-specific — the same partner or method. Login/logout belongs to user management; pay/card/refund belongs to payments.
tags.different_when: Same flow on different partners is related work but a DIFFERENT topic unless it is one rollout ('Apple Pay via Checkout' ≠ 'Apple Pay via Tap'). Same partner alone is never enough.
tags.example_same: 'Enable STC Pay on hosted checkout' across design + eng threads.
tags.example_different: 'Add Tabby 4-installments' ↔ 'Tabby settlement report format' — same partner, different capabilities.

tags.classify_when: Deploys, config flips, migrations, infra changes, feature-flag toggles.
tags.same_when: The same change or rollout (same PR/ticket/flag), including its follow-ups and incidents it caused.
tags.different_when: Routine deploys of different services or unrelated config changes.
tags.example_same: 'payments v2.31 deploy' ↔ 'rollback of v2.31 after refund errors'.

tags.classify_when: Someone asks how something works, where something lives, or requests access/permissions.
tags.same_when: The same question subject (same system, same process), even phrased differently.
tags.different_when: Different subjects that merely share vocabulary.
tags.example_same: 'How do refunds reach the ledger?' asked twice, months apart.
tags.example_different: 'How do refunds work?' ↔ 'How do refund REPORTS work?'

tags.classify_when: Coordination with an external partner in a shared (ext-*) channel: escalations, API changes, settlement queries.
tags.same_when: The same case/ticket/incident with that partner — a partner-channel escalation and the internal thread about the same case are the SAME topic.
tags.different_when: Same partner, different cases. The partner name alone is NEVER sufficient.
tags.example_same: 'ext-wego-juspay: refund age limit for old orders' ↔ internal 'Juspay 12-month refund limit' thread.

tie_breakers: A shared concrete identifier (payment id, order ref, Jira key, PR number, error signature) ⇒ SAME topic, regardless of tags.
Cross-tag pairs are allowed: a bug_incident and the ops_investigation or partner_comm about the same mechanism/case are the SAME topic.
Same partner or same vocabulary is NEVER sufficient on its own.
When genuinely uncertain after applying the rules, answer DIFFERENT (precision over recall — a missed link is cheaper than a wrong one).

payments.note: Grounded in the payments repo (pkg/constant, pkg/payment). Partner-specific work should match on partner+flow, not partner alone.
partners: juspay (India orchestration; Worldpay + TripleA crypto route through it)
method_families: cards (visa, mastercard, amex, mada, knet, rupay, unionpay, …)
